book.name: Aisaiya
book.title: Aisaiya Aisaiya Bin Gibit Wed Brom God

content: YAWEI bin tok langa Aisaiya langa drim langa det Serramoni Pleis

Wal aibin kipgon tok, “Langa det yiya na wen Yusaiya bin dai, aibin abum drim en langa main drim aibin luk YAWEI det trubala God bin jidanbat langa im speshalwan tjeya, en imbin jidan mowa haibala langa ola ebrijing, en blanga im klos bin spredat oloba langa det Serramoni Pleis.

En rait raun langa im, detlot speshalwan einjul gulum serif bin flairanbat en olabat bin brabli shainiwan, en olabat bin abum siksbala wing. En olabat bin gaburrumap olabat feis garram dubala wing, en olabat bin gaburrumap olabat bodi garram naja dubala wing. En garram det naja dubala wing olabat bin yusum blanga flairanbat,
en olabat bin oldei jinginatbat gija,

content.text: Im garram mowa pawa langa enijing langa dijan wel.’

content: “Wal wen detlot serif bin jinginat adbala det flopat blanga det Serramoni Pleis bin sheik nomo lilbit, en det Serramoni Pleis bin jidan garram loda smok.

“Afta na aibin jingat, ‘Trubala ai garra dai na. Aibin oldei toktokbat nogudbalawei, en detlot hubin jidan raidaran langa mi deibin oldei toktokbat nogudbalawei du. Bat tudei na aibin luk garram main ronwan ai det King, YAWEI det boswan God.’
“Brom deya wanbala serif bin flai langa mi garram det hotwan tjakol langa im bingga, weya imbin gajim brom det teibul blanga ofring garram det silbawan ting.
Imbin kaman en tatjim main mawus garram det hotwan tjakol en imbin tok, ‘Dijan bin tatjim yu mawus, en yu fri na brom ol det nogudbalawei en yu nomo giltiwan na.’
“Afta tharran aibin irrim YAWEI tok na, ‘Hu ai garra jandim? Enibodi iya gin jidan mesinja blanga wi?’ “Wal aibin tok, ‘Ai gin go. Yu jandim mi.’

“Wal YAWEI bin dalim mi blanga go en dalim im pipul olabat dislot wed na, ‘Yumob garra lisin main wed, bat yumob kaan sabi enijing. Yumob garra lukabat det trubalawei blanga God, bat yumob kaan faindim det wei.’

En YAWEI bin tok langa mi, ‘Yu meigim dislot pipul gibit mi bekboun. Jadimap olabat irriwol en olabat dubala ai en meigim olabat nomo sabi enijing wulijim olabat kaan kambek langa mi blanga meigim olabat gudbala.’ Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

“Aibin askim YAWEI na, ‘Haulong dijan ting garra jidan lagijat?’ “Wal YAWEI bin tok langa mi, ‘Raidap olabat haus garra buldan en olabat taun garra bitsap en raidap olabat fam garra jidan nomo garram enijing,
en aibin jandimwei olabat longwei en nomo enibodi bin jidan deya en det kantri bin jidan rabishwan.

Nomeda if oni lilbit pipul jidan laibala, bat stil olabat garra ol binijap. Bat jis laik det rutpat blanga det tri weya jidan afta deibin kadimdan, wal sambala pipul weya aibin pikimat garra jidan laibala lagijat du.’ Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.”
